invariants.rationale: newDrawable returns a Drawable object, so the result should not be null if the drawable with the given name exists.
The name parameter is used to look up a drawable; it should not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
The red (r) component of a Color is typically between 0 and 1 in libGDX.
The green (g) component of a Color is typically between 0 and 1 in libGDX.
The blue (b) component of a Color is typically between 0 and 1 in libGDX.
